### Select Other Provider in Connect CLI

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Initiate the provider setup flow by selecting 'Other' from the /connect command menu.

```bash
$ /connect

┌  Add credential
│
◆  Select provider
│  ...
│  ● Other
└
```

--------------------------------

### Run connect command for OpenCode Zen

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Execute the connect command in the TUI to initiate provider setup for OpenCode Zen.

```txt
/connect
```

### List recommended models for OpenCode Zen

```txt
/models
```

### Enter API Key in Connect CLI

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Store the credential for your custom provider ID via the CLI prompt.

```bash
$ /connect

┌  Add credential
│
▲  This only stores a credential for myprovider - you will need to configure it in opencode.json, check the docs for examples.
│
◇  Enter your API key
│  sk-...
└
```

```txt
┌ Enter your DigitalOcean Model Access Key
│
│
└ enter
```

--------------------------------

### Configure Advanced Provider Options and Token Limits in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Configure environment variable API keys, custom headers, and model context/output limits.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "myprovider": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "My AI Provider Display Name",
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "https://api.myprovider.com/v1",
        "apiKey": "{env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}",
        "headers": {
          "Authorization": "Bearer custom-token"
        }
      },
      "models": {
        "my-model-name": {
          "name": "My Model Display Name",
          "limit": {
            "context": 200000,
            "output": 65536
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Configure Custom OpenAI-Compatible Provider in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Define basic provider details, baseURL, and available models in the project configuration.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "myprovider": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "My AI Provider Display Name",
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "https://api.myprovider.com/v1"
      },
      "models": {
        "my-model-name": {
          "name": "My Model Display Name"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Pull cloud model information using Ollama CLI

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Pulls cloud model metadata locally before using the model within OpenCode.

```bash
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b-cloud
```

--------------------------------

### Configure OpenRouter provider routing options in JSON

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Customizes model options such as provider routing order and fallback behavior in opencode.json.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "openrouter": {
      "models": {
        "moonshotai/kimi-k2": {
          "options": {
            "provider": {
              "order": ["baseten"],
              "allow_fallbacks": false
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Configure local Ollama provider in JSON

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Defines custom local Ollama configuration using the OpenAI-compatible SDK package. Adjust num_ctx in Ollama if tool calling requires larger context.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "ollama": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "Ollama (local)",
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "http://localhost:11434/v1"
      },
      "models": {
        "llama2": {
          "name": "Llama 2"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Specify Provider ID in Connect CLI

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Set a unique ID during the interactive prompt to reference in configuration files.

```bash
$ /connect

┌  Add credential
│
◇  Enter provider id
│  myprovider
└
```

--------------------------------

### Configure provider base URL in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Set a custom base URL under the provider's options object. Useful when routing requests through proxies or custom endpoints.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "anthropic": {
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "https://api.anthropic.com/v1"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Add custom OpenRouter model in JSON

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Adds additional OpenRouter models through the opencode.json configuration file.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "openrouter": {
      "models": {
        "somecoolnewmodel": {}
      }
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Export DigitalOcean Model Access Token Environment Variable

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Set the environment variable in your shell session as an alternative to interactive CLI authentication.

```bash
export DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN=your-model-access-key
```

--------------------------------

### Restrict available models using whitelist in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Limits the /models picker to only the specified model IDs and hides all other models from the provider.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "anthropic": {
      "whitelist": ["claude-sonnet-4-20250514"]
    }
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Hide models using blacklist in opencode.json

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/web/src/content/docs/providers.mdx

Removes specified model IDs from the /models picker. Can be combined with whitelist to exclude specific models from an allowed list.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "anthropic": {
      "blacklist": ["claude-opus-4-20250514"]
    }
  }
}
```
